李班长开着吉普一路疾驰。草原上的路坑坑洼洼的，但李班长开得快，车颠得厉害，王建新抓着扶手，屁股一会儿弹起来一会儿落下去。到了中午，车也没停下。

王建新从兜里拿出一把牛肉干递给李班长一些。牛肉干是风干的，硬邦邦的，但嚼着香。李班长接过去，咬了一口，眼睛亮了：“好东西！”两人边吃边赶路，谁也不说话，就听着引擎的轰鸣声和轮胎碾过土路的声音。

当赶到团部的时候，已经到了下午五点多了。团部在旗里边，一栋三层小楼，好几排砖瓦房，一个操场，几棵杨树。门口有哨兵，背着枪，看见吉普车过来，敬了个礼。李班长停好车，带着王建新来到了张团长办公室。

办公楼不大，三层，灰砖墙，木门窗。走廊里安安静静的，只有脚步声在回荡。李班长敲了敲门，里面传来一声“进来”。两人推门进去，立正，向张团长敬礼，齐声喊道：“首长好！”

张团长坐在办公桌后面，正在看文件。他抬起头，看见王建新，脸上露出了笑容。他放下笔，回了个礼，然后对李班长说：“辛苦了，先回去休息吧。”李班长应了一声，转身出去了。

张团长从办公桌后面出来，走到会客沙发跟前，拍了拍沙发：“来来来，坐。”王建新规规矩矩地坐下，腰板挺得直直的。张团长坐在侧面的单人沙发上，热情地嘘寒问暖：“路上累不累？饿不饿？小李那小子开车快，没把你颠坏吧？”

王建新笑着摇了摇头：“不累，不饿，李班长车开得稳。”

“稳什么稳，他那开车技术我知道，跟开坦克似的。”张团长哈哈笑了两声，又问，“在哨点收拾东西了？都带齐了？”

“带齐了，也没什么东西。”

两人正说着话，门又被推开了。李参谋长走了进来，穿着一身军装，四个兜的军装，证明这是一名领导。65式军装都一样，军官和士兵的区分就是四个口袋和两个口袋。他看见王建新，脸上也露出了笑容。王建新立马站起，立正敬礼，喊道：“首长好！”

李参谋长回了个礼，摆了摆手示意他坐下，问道：“多会到的，小王同志？”

王建新答道：“刚到了团部，才坐下。”

李参谋长走到另一侧沙发，坐了下来。他看了看张团长，又看了看王建新，开口道：“特招入伍，团部直接就可以办理。提干需要上级批准，这个得等一等。至于上学，这个需要一些时间来筹备。”他顿了顿，看着王建新，“关于上学，你准备以后走指挥路线还是技术路线？说说你的想法。”

王建新犹豫了一下。指挥路线——就是当指挥员，带兵打仗。技术路线——就是当技术干部，搞专业。他想了想，说：“首长，我可不可以学医呀？”

“学医？”李参谋长微微一愣。

王建新解释道：“我小时候和姥爷学过一段时间中医，我发现我对医术比较感兴趣，而且也学得很快。现在国家不是提倡中西医结合嘛，我觉得学医挺好的。”

李参谋长“哦”了一声，点点头说：“对医术感兴趣呀？现在国家正缺各种人才，当然可以。但是学医只能联系北京中医院或者北京医学院。这两个医院招收三年制工农兵学员，咱们部队可以推荐入学，毕业后获大专学历。以后可以留在军区医院工作。

王建新想到能去北京中医院或者北京医学院都不错，在北京，离家近。他点点头，说：“首长，我想学医。以后为战士们治病。如果有战争，我还可以去战场上当军医，可以抢救更多受伤的战友。”

张团长直接大声说道：“好！国家就需要像你这样的有为青年。”他转过头，对李参谋长说，“老李，剩下的手续你来跑，咱们把小王同志推荐过去。现在先把小王同志的特招手续办完，先成为一名光荣的战士。等上级把提干手续批下来后，你就是一名排长了。”他看向王建新，严肃地说，“一定要以身作则。以后要记住自己的身份，你是一名军人，你的一言一行不光代表自己，也代表着咱们部队的形象。”

王建新立马站起立正，向两位首长敬礼，然后说道：“两位首长放心，我保证不会抹黑咱们军人的形象。”

张团长满意地点了点头，喊了一声通讯员。门开了，一个年轻的警卫员走进来，立正敬礼。张团长说：“带小王同志去宿舍看看。”

“是！”警卫员应了一声，转身对王建新说，“同志，跟我来。”

王建新跟着警卫员出了办公楼。走廊里，他看见李班长正站在门口，手里拎着他的行李卷和网兜。王建新赶忙接过来，向李班长道谢：“李班长，辛苦了，谢谢你。”

李班长笑了笑，拍了拍他的肩膀：“好好干，小王同志。”说完转身走了。

Monitor Li drove the jeep and drove all the way.The road on the grassland was full of potholes, but Squad Leader Li was driving fast, and the car bumped violently. Wang Jianxin grabbed the handrail, and his buttocks bounced up and down.At noon, the car didn't stop.

Wang Jianxin took out a handful of beef jerky from his pocket and handed some to Captain Li.The beef jerky is air-dried and hard, but chewy.Squad leader Li took it and took a bite, his eyes lit up: "Good stuff!" The two of them ate and hurried on, neither of them talking, just listening to the roar of the engine and the sound of tires running over the dirt road.

When we arrived at the regiment headquarters, it was already past five in the afternoon.The regiment headquarters is inside the flag, a three-story building, several rows of brick buildings, a playground, and a few poplar trees.There was a sentry at the door with a gun on his back. When he saw the jeep coming, he saluted.Squad leader Li parked the car and took Wang Jianxin to Captain Zhang's office.

The office building is small, with three floors, gray brick walls, and wooden doors and windows.The corridor was quiet, with only the sound of footsteps echoing.Monitor Li knocked on the door, and a "Come in" came from inside.The two pushed the door open, stood at attention, saluted Captain Zhang, and shouted in unison: "Hello, Chief!"

Captain Zhang was sitting behind his desk, reading documents.He raised his head and saw Wang Jianxin, with a smile on his face.He put down his pen, returned the salute, and then said to Squad Leader Li: "Thank you for your hard work, go back and rest first." Squad Leader Li responded, turned around and went out.

Captain Zhang came out from behind the desk, walked to the guest sofa, and patted the sofa: "Come on, come on, sit down." Wang Jianxin sat down in a dignified manner, with his back straight.Captain Zhang sat on the single sofa on the side and asked warmly: "Are you tired from the road? Are you hungry? That guy Xiao Li drives very fast, didn't he hurt you?"

Wang Jianxin smiled and shook his head: "I'm not tired, I'm not hungry. Squad Leader Li is driving steadily."

"What is stable? I know his driving skills, it's like driving a tank." Captain Zhang laughed twice and asked again, "Have you packed your things at the sentry point? Have you brought everything?"

"I brought everything, but there's nothing."

While the two were talking, the door was pushed open again.Chief of Staff Li walked in, wearing a military uniform with four pockets, proving that he was a leader.The Type 65 military uniforms are all the same. The difference between officers and soldiers is four pockets and two pockets.When he saw Wang Jianxin, a smile appeared on his face.Wang Jianxin immediately stood up, stood at attention, saluted, and shouted: "Hello, Chief!"

Chief of Staff Li returned the salute, waved his hand for him to sit down, and asked, "How long will you be here, Comrade Xiao Wang?"

Wang Jianxin replied: "I just sat down when I arrived at the regiment headquarters."

Chief of Staff Li walked to the sofa on the other side and sat down.He looked at Captain Zhang, then at Wang Jianxin, and said: "For special recruitment, the regiment headquarters can handle it directly. Promotion requires approval from superiors, and this will have to wait. As for going to school, this will take some time to prepare." He paused, looked at Wang Jianxin, "As for going to school, are you planning to take the command route or the technical route in the future? Tell me what you think."

Wang Jianxin hesitated.The command line is to be a commander and lead troops to fight.The technical route is to be a technical cadre and be professional.He thought for a while and said, "Chief, can I study medicine?"

"Study medicine?" Chief of Staff Li was slightly startled.

Wang Jianxin explained: "When I was a child, I studied traditional Chinese medicine with my grandpa for a while. I found that I was more interested in medical skills and I learned quickly. Doesn't the country now advocate the integration of traditional Chinese and Western medicine? I think it is good to study medicine."

Chief of Staff Li said "Oh", nodded and said: "Are you interested in medical skills? The country is currently short of various talents, of course. But to study medicine, you can only contact Beijing Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine or Beijing Medical College. These two hospitals recruit three-year workers, peasants and soldiers students. Our army can recommend them to enroll and obtain a college degree after graduation. You can stay in the military hospital to work in the future.

Wang Jianxin thought that it would be good to go to Beijing Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine or Beijing Medical College. They were in Beijing and close to home.He nodded and said, "Chief, I want to study medicine.From now on, he will treat the soldiers.If there is a war, I can also go to the battlefield as a military doctor and rescue more injured comrades."

Captain Zhang said loudly: "Okay!The country needs promising young people like you.He turned his head and said to Chief of Staff Li, "Old Li, you can handle the rest of the procedures. We will recommend Comrade Xiao Wang."Now let’s complete the special recruitment procedures for Comrade Xiao Wang and become a glorious warrior first.After your superiors approve the transfer procedures, you will be a platoon leader.He looked at Wang Jianxin and said seriously, "You must lead by example."In the future, you must remember your identity. You are a soldier. Your words and deeds not only represent yourself, but also represent the image of our army."

Wang Jianxin immediately stood up at attention, saluted the two chiefs, and then said: "Two chiefs, don't worry, I promise that I will not smear the image of our soldiers."

Captain Zhang nodded with satisfaction and called the correspondent.The door opened, and a young guard walked in, standing at attention and saluting.Captain Zhang said: "Take Comrade Xiao Wang to the dormitory to have a look."

"yes!The guard responded, turned to Wang Jianxin and said, "Comrade, follow me.""

Wang Jianxin followed the security guard out of the office building.In the corridor, he saw Squad Leader Li standing at the door, holding his luggage roll and net bag.Wang Jianxin hurriedly took it and thanked Squad Leader Li: "Team Leader Li, thank you for your hard work."

Squad leader Li smiled and patted him on the shoulder: "Do a good job, Comrade Xiao Wang."After that, he turned around and left.
